Name: Guided Rounds v1.9.13
Description: 把 P-92 法令手枪的原版制导移植到武器清单里的每一把枪上：弹丸出膛后自动追踪敌人，伤害和初速保持武器原本的数值。带索敌范围圆环、目标锁定标记与方框，全部参数可在游戏内 MODS 菜单实时调整。需要 Bingus Shared Loader v15+ 与 HD2Runtime。v1.8.1 是代码健壮性与可读性优化（玩法与 v1.8.0 一致，另修掉四处会报错的隐患）；v1.8.2 修掉锁定目标方框在切换武器后残留的问题。v1.9.0 枪械按类型分页、瞄准优先级按阵营分页，并移除无敌的认知干扰器本体。v1.9.11 修好单枪优先级按手上的枪取表、自定义未指向该枪、换枪后模式滞后，以及 0 视作未设置。v1.9.12 修好个别光能族（尤其无票者）锁不上：死亡缓存只认 status=2，无票者的衰减宪法值不再把活体锁出候选；全零骨骼视为读不到。v1.9.13 把弹丸材质加载内置：装了 HD2Runtime 0.40.1 或更旧版本时交给它（队友同步材质），更新版本或未安装时由内置装载器请求资源包。  |  Guided rounds ported from the P-92 Warrant to every weapon on the list, with an aim-cone range ring, a lock marker and a target box, all tunable from the in-game MODS tab. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v15+ and HD2Runtime. v1.8.1 is a robustness and readability pass (gameplay unchanged from v1.8.0, plus four latent crash fixes); v1.8.2 fixes the lock target box that stayed on screen after a weapon switch. v1.9.0 groups weapons by class and splits manual priority by faction. v1.9.11 fixes per-weapon priority reading the weapon in hand, CUSTOM not arming that weapon's table, a stale mode after a weapon switch, and 0 meaning unset. v1.9.12 fixes Illuminate units (Voteless most of all) that could not be locked: only status=2 (the real death mark) condemns a unit; all-zero bones are unreadable. v1.9.13 loads projectile materials without a mandatory runtime: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 or older still handles the request (so clients get synced assets), while a newer runtime, or none, is served by the built-in loader.
